design: All twelve observed E46 cases, ten frozen methods. Same 32 original probes, then all geometry contype/conaffinity disabled. Fixed complete 1700-step schedule, no early stopping or object feedback. Native nominal nine pose waypoints and original phase budgets (220,260,60,260,260,260,60,260,60). One schedule per case starts at calibrated analytical tool position; ramp .002 m/step continuously across phases, independent of model observations. Native aperture sequence retained. Tool-Z target +Z. Same gains/damping/clips/limits/online updates.
metrics: Phase passes only if all final eight samples have goal XYZ error <.006 m and tool-Z direction norm <.08. Complete schedule passes all nine phases. Also retain tracking RMS, joint speeds and action clipping. No velocity threshold, task-success termination or outcome filtering.
limits: Artificial unconstrained tracking, not manipulation, safety or deployable success. Fixed nominal tool poses omit object-offset correction and object-height early release. Observed development cases and two native robot designs, not independent novel-embodiment validation. No training or parameter tuning.
